name: Odd-Eyes Steamtech Dragon
text:
1 "Steamtech" Fusion Monster + 1 "Odd-Eyes pendulum Dragon"
This monster gains ATK equal to the level of the "Steamtech" Monster used to summon this card x300. Once Per Turn: you can banish up to 3 "Steamtech" or "Odd-Eyes" Dragon monsters from your GY, this card can make an extra attack equal to the number of cards banished. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. also this card cannot be targeted by card effect.
